caption: The drawing depicts an object composed primarily of two main materials: metal and wood. The central feature is a metal mechanical device, which includes a conical funnel that widens at the top and tapers downward, connected to a cylindrical mechanism with gears and levers. Attached to the right side of this device is a prominently visible hand crank with a rounded, turned wooden handle. The metal parts show a consistent brownish, slightly rusty color, with visible bolts and seams. The entire device is mounted on a vertically positioned, rectangular block of wood with a natural grain pattern, brown in color, and rounded edges at both ends. The background is a plain, light beige. No other objects or embellishments are present in the composition.
title: Grinder
